description.zh: 围绕单一转化目标纵向组织信息的营销页面：顶部导航与 Hero 主视觉先讲清楚"这是什么、好在哪"， 中段用功能区、信任区（客户 logo、评价、数据）逐层打消顾虑，末端以强视觉的行动按钮收口。 页面按说服顺序分区，每一屏都在回答用户下一步的疑问。
description.en: A marketing page organized vertically around one conversion goal: nav and hero explain "what is this and why it's good", mid-sections use features and social proof (logos, testimonials, numbers) to dissolve objections, and a strong call-to-action closes. Sections follow the persuasion order — each screen answers the visitor's next question.

use_when.zh: 推广单一产品或活动、追求注册/购买转化
use_when.en: Promoting one product or campaign, chasing signups or sales

use_when.zh: 来自广告或外链的访客需要快速理解价值
use_when.en: Visitors from ads or links must grasp value fast

use_when.zh: 需要在无登录状态下完成首次转化
use_when.en: First conversion must happen without logging in

avoid_when.zh: 已登录用户的日常工作界面
信息层级复杂、需长期维护的内容站（用文档站更合适）
avoid_when.en: Complex long-lived content sites — use documentation instead

avoid_when.zh: 需要频繁检索的数据库型页面
avoid_when.en: Database-like pages that need frequent lookup

note.zh: 大标题 + 主图 + 单一 CTA，最通用
note.en: Big headline + visual + one CTA, the general default

note.zh: Hero 之后用卡片矩阵罗列功能点
note.en: Card matrix of features right after the hero

note.zh: 一屏一个论点，逐屏滚动说服
note.en: One point per screen, scroll-driven persuasion

note.zh: 只有 Hero + 邮箱收集，产品未上线时用
note.en: Hero + email capture only, for pre-launch

note.zh: Logo + 锚点导航 + 主 CTA，首屏常透明悬浮。
note.en: Logo, anchor nav and primary CTA, often transparent over the hero.

note.zh: 一句价值主张 + 主 CTA，首屏必须说清「是什么、给谁」。
note.en: A value proposition plus primary CTA; the first screen must say what and for whom.

note.zh: 3–6 个能力点，图文并排，支撑价值主张。
note.en: Three to six benefits with visuals, backing the value proposition.

note.zh: 客户 logo 墙、用户评价或关键数据。
note.en: Customer logos, testimonials or key numbers.

note.zh: 页尾前的最后一次转化催促，重复主 CTA。
note.en: A final conversion push that repeats the primary CTA.

note.zh: 站点地图、法律与社交链接，收束整页。
note.en: Sitemap, legal and social links closing the page.

notes.zh: 页面纵向由 section 串联：hero 通常 100vh 或近满屏，功能区用 grid 自适应卡片， 信任区一行 logo + 评价卡。CTA 按钮全局唯一强调色并重复出现（hero 与页脚前各一次）。 长滚动变体可用 scroll-snap 分屏；进场动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: Sections stacked vertically: hero fills or nearly fills the viewport, features adapt as a card grid, social proof is a logo row plus testimonial cards. One accent CTA color, repeated before the footer. The long-scroll variant can use scroll-snap; entry animations respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个产品落地页，包含 Hero、功能区、用户评价和行动按钮。
basic.en: Create a product landing page with a hero, feature sections, testimonials and a call-to-action.

design.zh: 创建 SaaS 产品落地页：吸顶导航（logo + 锚点 + 登录/注册按钮）；Hero 大标题 + 副标题 + 邮箱输入与主按钮；下方客户 logo 一排；功能区 3 列卡片；评价区 2～3 条带头像的引用；页脚前重复一条强 CTA 横幅。响应式、深浅色一致。
design.en: Build a SaaS landing page: sticky nav (logo + anchor links + login/signup); hero with headline, subcopy, email input and primary button; a logo row; three-column feature cards; two to three testimonials with avatars; a strong CTA banner before the footer. Responsive and theme-consistent.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Landing Page：语义化 section + 锚点导航；邮箱表单做基础校验与成功态； 卡片进场用 IntersectionObserver 触发渐入（尊重 prefers-reduced-motion）； 图片用 loading="lazy"；CTA 事件可埋点。不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind landing page: semantic sections with anchor nav; email form with basic validation and success state; cards fade in via IntersectionObserver (respecting prefers-reduced-motion); lazy-load images; CTA ready for analytics. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现产品落地页。

先检查现有设计 Token、品牌色与已有营销页组件，保持一致。
要求：
- 语义化 section 结构与锚点导航
- Hero + 邮箱收集表单（校验 + 成功态）
- 功能卡片、信任区、重复 CTA
- 响应式与深浅色一致，动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the product landing page in the current project.

Inspect design tokens, brand colors and existing marketing components first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Semantic sections with anchor navigation
- Hero with email capture (validation + success state)
- Feature cards, social proof, repeated CTA
- Responsive, consistent light/dark; animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
